integrity: The analytical proof is self-contained for the new stationary-law, tail and crossover statements. An accompanying exact symbolic checker reproduces the map identities and critical constants, and finite numerical excursion tests are explicitly distinguished from proof. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns one explicit rational map and its specified invariant carriers, not every invariant measure in the plane; the circular-rotation conjugacy and conic framework were known. Other projective-distribution results may bear on priority. Below-cutoff Birkhoff convergence is almost everywhere. Nonintegrable moments diverge for all complete orbits on the carrier.
title: A heavy-tail phase transition and two-sided scaling law for a rational planar map
